rowText.steps: Get a stopped reply so Retry is a D-pad stop, focus Retry, press Up.
rowText.expected: Should land back on the answer's last section; bug says it does not.

reads.setup: Asked a long Hades weapons question, pressed Stop generation partway through (question box -> Right -> Right -> A), producing a genuinely stopped/partial reply with its own Retry icon.
reads.pressedUp: landed on '12 earlier' (the collapsed-history pill above the question), not on the kept partial answer text

verdictSentence: On a reply that was actually stopped partway through, pressing up from the Retry button skips past the kept answer text entirely and jumps to the collapsed 'earlier turns' pill above it -- the bug is still there.
